n2baddaafca.why: Tencent is a major Chinese internet group with large gaming, advertising and cloud businesses, and it is a heavyweight in Hong Kong-listed tech stocks.

n36426938fe.why: The State Bank of Vietnam sets monetary policy, which influences interest rates, credit growth and the dong's stability.

n4088569c3d.why: Tourism is a major part of Croatia's economy, and hotel investment sentiment signals expected demand and capital spending in the sector.

n8b02ab694e.summary: Former Greek prime minister Alexis Tsipras cited Eurostat data showing VAT revenue rose by 8 billion and income tax revenue by 10 billion. He criticised tax exemptions on large wealth.
n8b02ab694e.why: Tax policy on wealth and consumption determines government revenue and fiscal space in Greece, which matters for sovereign bond investors.

n1533996d10.headline: Kazakhstan Economy Grows 4.1% as Non-Oil Sectors Expand
n1533996d10.summary: Kazakhstan's economy grew 4.1%, with non-oil sectors expanding. The figure is a headline macroeconomic indicator for the Central Asian economy.
n1533996d10.why: Kazakhstan is a major oil producer in Central Asia, and growth outside oil signals the diversification of its economy.

n122365a00d.headline: Zambia awaits presidential election results. Here's why China and the US may be interested
n122365a00d.summary: Zambia is awaiting results that will decide whether President Hakainde Hichilema wins a second five-year term based on his economic recovery plan. The article notes interest from China and the US.
n122365a00d.why: Zambia is a major copper producer, and election outcomes shape its debt restructuring, mining policy and relations with major creditors and investors.

n9c4c91bac1.headline: Ukraine halts strikes on tankers using Russian port at US request, FT says
n9c4c91bac1.summary: Ukraine has paused drone strikes on oil tankers using Russia's Black Sea port of Novorossiysk after a request from US Vice President JD Vance, the Financial Times reported. The report cites Ukrainian officials.
n9c4c91bac1.why: Novorossiysk is a major Russian crude and oil-products export terminal, so attacks on tankers there can disrupt global oil shipments.

n6f2216ca23.headline: Tui profits slump as Iran war hits holiday demand
n6f2216ca23.summary: Europe's largest travel operator, TUI, reported a profit slump as the Iran war hit holiday demand, with holidaymakers increasingly booking trips at the last minute.
n6f2216ca23.why: TUI is a major European tour operator, and its results reflect consumer travel demand and booking patterns across Europe.

n47fbe62038.headline: DESMOND LACHMAN | Trump faces midterm reckoning as economic promises go unfulfilled
n47fbe62038.summary: The US president's economic record leaves him vulnerable ahead of November's midterm elections, according to a Business Day analysis by Desmond Lachman.
n47fbe62038.why: US midterm elections can shift control of Congress, which affects fiscal policy, trade and regulation that matter to investors.

nfcf329729e.headline: N Chandrasekaran resigns as chairman of Tata Sons before AGM
nfcf329729e.summary: N Chandrasekaran has stepped down as Tata Sons chairman, ending a significant tenure. His departure follows disagreements within Tata Trusts over business performance and capital needs.
nfcf329729e.why: Tata Sons is the holding company of the Tata group, one of India's largest conglomerates, and its chairman sets strategy across many listed subsidiaries.

n2fb852ce41.headline: Australia's largest aluminium smelter expected to get emergency bailout
n2fb852ce41.summary: The prime minister and New South Wales premier are expected to announce a bailout for Australia's largest aluminium smelter the following day.
n2fb852ce41.why: Aluminium smelters are energy-intensive plants, and government support decisions affect industrial jobs and metals supply.

n01476d3e00.headline: Uber bike taxi expansion: Uber takes bike taxis to 100 more cities in India as Rapido rivalry intensifies
n01476d3e00.summary: Uber is expanding its two-wheeler Uber Bike service to 100 more Indian cities across 18 states and one Union territory. The move intensifies competition with Rapido.
n01476d3e00.why: Uber is a global ride-hailing platform, and India is one of its largest growth markets for low-cost urban mobility.

nfa9b82ae21.headline: Power debts rise as end of bill relief hits home
nfa9b82ae21.summary: AGL, an electricity and gas supplier, accepted the end of federal government bill relief. Cost-of-living pressures are hitting households.
nfa9b82ae21.why: AGL Energy is one of Australia's largest electricity and gas retailers, so changes to customer bill support affect its revenues and bad-debt exposure.

n313169686c.headline: Wall Street rises near a record as AI stocks climb and worries about inflation ease a bit
n313169686c.summary: Wall Street finished just shy of a record Wednesday as AI stocks reported stronger spring growth than expected. A US inflation report showed prices rose slightly less than feared last month.
n313169686c.why: The Dow Jones Industrial Average and Nasdaq Composite are the main US benchmarks, and AI-linked stocks are a large share of recent index gains.

n04346f07e1.summary: The Treasurer says housing growth can continue despite a collapse in property investor lending since the federal budget. He argues the slowdown is good for the economy in the long term.
n04346f07e1.why: Investor lending is a key driver of Australian residential property demand, which affects banks' loan books and the construction sector.

n6e3a82e702.headline: Inflation eases in July as gasoline and grocery prices fall
n6e3a82e702.summary: US consumer prices rose 3.4% from a year earlier in July, a smaller annual increase than in May or June, making a Federal Reserve rate hike in September less likely.
n6e3a82e702.why: Consumer inflation data guides Federal Reserve policy, which sets borrowing costs and drives moves in bond yields, the dollar and equity valuations.
n6e3a82e702.why_moved: Inflation eased in July as gasoline and grocery prices fell, reducing the chance of a September Fed rate increase.

n3351ee4825.headline: Power debts rise as end of bill relief hits home
n3351ee4825.summary: Electricity and gas supplier AGL accepted the end of federal government bill relief, and cost-of-living pressures are hitting households.
n3351ee4825.why: AGL Energy is one of Australia's largest electricity and gas retailers, so its customer pricing reflects national energy policy.

n27a237e739.headline: Bill proposes licensing rules, fee cap for foreign booking platforms - Türkiye News
n27a237e739.summary: A bill submitted to parliament by AKP lawmakers would require foreign-based online accommodation platforms to obtain a permit from the Culture and Tourism Ministry. It also sets a 17% ceiling on their fees.
n27a237e739.why: Online booking platforms take commissions on hotel and rental bookings, so fee caps and licensing rules directly change their economics in tourism markets.

nc5c37524cd.headline: UAE Offers to Shuttle Iraqi Oil through Hormuz
nc5c37524cd.summary: ADNOC is offering to shuttle Iraqi crude exports through the Strait of Hormuz, using its dark-transit approach to deliver Basrah and other grades to Asian refiners. The plan was reported citing people familiar with the matter.
nc5c37524cd.why: ADNOC is Abu Dhabi's state oil company, and Hormuz is the main sea route for Gulf crude exports.

n066f7cfd2f.headline: Oil prices rise, stocks mixed ahead of crucial US inflation data - Latest News
n066f7cfd2f.summary: Oil prices rose again on August 12 while stock markets were mixed. Investors were focused on upcoming US inflation data that could guide Federal Reserve rate decisions.
n066f7cfd2f.why: US inflation data shapes Federal Reserve policy expectations, which influence bond yields, equity valuations and the dollar.

n661c8548a4.headline: Premiums rising at double inflation rate, insurer says
n661c8548a4.summary: The cost of insurance is rising at nearly double the rate of inflation, according to Australia's biggest insurer.
n661c8548a4.why: Insurance premiums are a significant household and business cost, and insurer pricing affects the profitability of listed insurers.

n686643af7f.headline: Guiding Innovation Resources to Concentrate in Key Areas
n686643af7f.summary: The State Council recently issued the Fifteenth Five-Year Plan for intellectual property protection and application. It sets goals and key tasks for the next five years and targets enhanced IP competitiveness by 2030.
n686643af7f.why: Intellectual property policy shapes how innovation is protected and commercialized, which affects technology companies, licensing and foreign investors' view of China's regulatory environment.

n5ced00547c.headline: Treasurer tips housing growth despite investor slump
n5ced00547c.summary: The Australian Treasurer says a collapse in property investor lending since the federal budget is good for the economy over the long term. The remark was made in support of housing growth.
n5ced00547c.why: Investor lending drives a large share of Australian housing demand, so shifts in it affect bank loan books and residential property prices.

nc7a5cf9435.headline: India Retail Inflation Rises To 4.45% In July As Food Prices Stay Elevated
nc7a5cf9435.summary: India's retail inflation rose to 4.45% in July, the fourth straight monthly increase. Food inflation climbed to 5.52%, with rural areas seeing stronger price pressure.
nc7a5cf9435.why: Consumer inflation data guides the Reserve Bank of India's interest-rate decisions, which affect bond yields and the rupee.

n0adb0888bf.headline: Higher exit tax fails to fly with tourism sector
n0adb0888bf.summary: Travel industry figures have criticised a move to charge people leaving Australia more, saying it adds to existing costs for the tourism sector.
n0adb0888bf.why: Departure taxes affect airline demand and inbound and outbound tourism spending, which matter to travel operators and airlines.

n5a138009d1.headline: TCS shares tumble 4%, wipe out Rs 35,000 crore after N Chandrasekaran resigns. What should investors do?
n5a138009d1.summary: TCS shares fell nearly 4%, wiping ₹35,000 crore from market value after N Chandrasekaran resigned as Tata Sons chairman. Analysts called the reaction knee-jerk.
n5a138009d1.why: Tata Consultancy Services is India's largest IT services firm, and leadership changes at its parent group can affect investor confidence in the stock.
n5a138009d1.why_moved: Shares fell after N Chandrasekaran resigned as Tata Sons chairman. Analysts described the reaction as knee-jerk.

n82660809f1.headline: US forces disable Iran-bound ship with Hellfire missiles
n82660809f1.summary: U.S. forces used Hellfire missiles to disable a commercial vessel attempting to breach the American naval blockade against Iran, escalating Middle East tensions.
n82660809f1.why: Naval blockades disrupt shipping routes and can tighten oil and freight markets, making them relevant to energy and shipping investors.

n7a23b345a3.headline: Labour promised massive tax hike on businesses | Kiwiblog
n7a23b345a3.summary: Labour said it would scrap National's Investment Boost, the centrepiece of Budget 2025, under a plan focused on small businesses. National described the plan as harmful to investment.
n7a23b345a3.why: Tax incentives for business investment shape corporate capital spending and attract domestic and foreign capital.

n483995178d.summary: A multi-billion dollar bailout is planned for the Tomago aluminium smelter in the politically sensitive Hunter Region of New South Wales.
n483995178d.why: Tomago is one of Australia's largest aluminium smelters, and its operating viability affects regional jobs, power demand and national aluminium output.

n63fa285293.headline: Iran wants a mafia-style ‘protection’ toll on the Strait of Hormuz, but the eye-popping $20 billion per year haul is a pipe dream
n63fa285293.summary: Details of any tolling or voluntary fee system for the Strait of Hormuz are unlikely to be finalised in a potential interim deal, further delaying a permanent peace solution.
n63fa285293.why: Fees on Hormuz transit would raise shipping costs for oil and LNG cargoes, so the status of any toll affects energy trade economics.

n006ce497d6.headline: US, Iran Extend Islamabad Ceasefire
n006ce497d6.summary: The United States and Iran agreed to extend their ceasefire before the expiry of the 60-day deadline set under the Islamabad Memorandum. The extension was agreed ahead of the deadline.
n006ce497d6.why: A ceasefire between the two states reduces the risk of wider conflict that could disrupt Gulf oil supply and global markets.

n30946c48b6.headline: 'Good News': July Inflation Report Trend Earns Cheers From Financial Markets Analyst, White House
n30946c48b6.summary: The July inflation report showed easing core consumer prices, praised by financial market analysts and the White House. The report is a key input for Federal Reserve rate decisions.
n30946c48b6.why: Consumer price inflation data guides Federal Reserve rate policy, which sets the cost of borrowing and the valuation of equities and bonds.
n30946c48b6.why_moved: The July report showed easing core CPI, which analysts read as a favourable inflation trend. That could shift expectations for Federal Reserve policy.

nb07de05bbc.headline: Lawsuit seeks to ban Trump Media from charging for early access to president's posts on US policy
nb07de05bbc.summary: President Donald Trump was sued in federal court to stop him profiting from early, exclusive access to his Truth Social posts on US policy.
nb07de05bbc.why: Trump Media & Technology Group operates the Truth Social platform and is listed in the US, so legal and regulatory challenges affect its business model.

ne72a8ee2bf.headline: Investors lose Rs 68,000 crore as Tata stocks slide on Chandrasekaran's resignation
ne72a8ee2bf.summary: Tata Group company shares sold off broadly on Wednesday after N. Chandrasekaran decided not to seek reappointment as chairman, with investors losing Rs 68,000 crore.
ne72a8ee2bf.why: Tata Group is one of India's largest conglomerates, so leadership changes at its holding company affect many listed subsidiaries.
ne72a8ee2bf.why_moved: Shares of Tata Group companies fell broadly after Chandrasekaran said he would not seek reappointment as chairman, cutting market value sharply.

n37c3edbce3.summary: Japan's Nikkei 225 reached a record high of 67,524, driven by a weaker yen and a rally in AI and semiconductor stocks. Trading was subdued ahead of US inflation data.
n37c3edbce3.why: The Nikkei 225 is Japan's benchmark index of 225 leading companies, and a weaker yen tends to boost exporters' overseas earnings.

n74fea73c9f.summary: Adani Group Chairman Gautam Adani said the dismissal of the US criminal case left him with humility rather than triumph. He spoke on Wednesday.
n74fea73c9f.why: The Adani Group is a large Indian conglomerate spanning ports, energy and infrastructure. Legal developments around its leadership have affected investor sentiment toward its listed companies.

n214ac02bc8.headline: India's retail inflation edges up to 4.45 per cent in July
n214ac02bc8.summary: India's retail inflation, measured under the new Consumer Price Index series, edged up to 4.45% in July from the same month a year earlier.
n214ac02bc8.why: Retail inflation is the main gauge the Reserve Bank of India uses when setting interest rates. Changes in the rate of price growth influence bond yields and equity valuations.

n379dc87cb1.headline: Ex-Chinese Premier Zhu Rongji, who drove economic reforms and led China into the WTO, dies at 97
n379dc87cb1.summary: Former Chinese Premier Zhu Rongji has died, according to state media. He is known for driving economic reforms and leading China into the WTO.
n379dc87cb1.why: Zhu Rongji led major market-oriented reforms and China's World Trade Organization accession, which shaped China's integration into the global economy.

n93b2e3033d.headline: TNRERA grants four-month extension to real estate projects hit by West Asia conflict
n93b2e3033d.summary: The Tamil Nadu Real Estate Regulatory Authority granted a blanket four-month extension for registration and completion of projects affected by the West Asia conflict.
n93b2e3033d.why: Regulatory deadline extensions affect developers' timelines, costs and buyer commitments in India's housing sector.

n0f8d50e3c4.headline: Australia clears Integris deal for First Focus buy
n0f8d50e3c4.summary: Australia has approved Integris's deal to buy First Focus. The approval lets the managed services group, which serves 4,000 businesses, expand across Australia, New Zealand and the US.
n0f8d50e3c4.why: Integris is a managed services provider; approvals for acquisitions of this kind determine whether a deal can proceed and how the combined business grows across markets.

ne03716a9ec.headline: Leapmotor A05 EV hatchback enters China to take on Geely EX2
ne03716a9ec.summary: The Leapmotor A05 electric hatchback has begun presales in China, targeting the Geely EX2, which is described as a domestic bestseller in its segment.
ne03716a9ec.why: Leapmotor is a Chinese electric vehicle maker competing in the mass-market EV segment, where price and volume drive share in China's large car market.

n0451625fef.headline: Changan CS55 Plus HEV SUV launches August 18 in China with 44.28% thermal efficiency
n0451625fef.summary: The refreshed Changan CS55 Plus hybrid SUV launches in China on August 18 with Changan's BlueCore hybrid system, with pricing expected around 14,000 USD.
n0451625fef.why: Changan is a major Chinese automaker, and its hybrid lineup competes in China's rapidly growing new-energy vehicle market.

n8ddf1517ce.headline: Huge oil slick hitting Oman’s shoreline as agencies warn of disaster
n8ddf1517ce.summary: Oman's environment agency confirmed a vast oil spill from a leaking tanker has started to reach the coastline, threatening to become one of the world's worst in years.
n8ddf1517ce.why: Oman is a major oil exporter and its ports and coastline support shipping and energy flows through the Gulf of Oman. Spills can disrupt shipping, fisheries and tourism.

ne60c334962.summary: Former Chinese premier Zhu Rongji, who drove economic reforms in the 1990s, has died at 97. His reforms moved China toward a market-oriented financial system without ceding party control over the economy.
ne60c334962.why: Zhu led China's shift toward market-oriented finance in the 1990s, a foundation for the country's later integration into global trade and capital markets.

nd89fa0a80c.headline: Nelson Peltz
nd89fa0a80c.summary: Activist investor Nelson Peltz's firm is working with BlueFive Capital and franchisee Flynn Group on a proposal expected in the coming weeks.

ne1a4751fd4.headline: Hiroshi Okuda, who led Toyota's climb as a global automaker, dies at 93
ne1a4751fd4.summary: Hiroshi Okuda, former Toyota chief executive who led the Japanese automaker's rise in global markets, has died at 93.
ne1a4751fd4.why: Toyota is the world's largest automaker by many measures, and its leadership history shaped its global expansion.

nc8a1298fa9.headline: Align Technology Prevails in China Patent Infringement Action Against Angelalign
nc8a1298fa9.summary: Align Technology has prevailed in a patent infringement action in China against Angelalign. Align is a Nasdaq-listed medical device company that designs clear aligners.
nc8a1298fa9.why: Align Technology is the maker of Invisalign clear aligners, and its patent rights protect its market share in China.

n22bff8b967.headline: US yield curve twists expose Trump
n22bff8b967.summary: US bond yields are surging to unprecedented levels, placing the Trump administration in a tough spot. The Federal Reserve must weigh raising rates against price stability or cutting them and risking inflation.
n22bff8b967.why: Treasury yields set borrowing costs across the economy and influence the valuation of equities and other risk assets. The Federal Reserve sets the policy rate that anchors them.
n22bff8b967.why_moved: Surging yields reflect the tension between the White House's push for lower rates and Treasury's focus on inflation and bond yields, as described in the report.

n0d3077f1df.headline: Accel’s $550 million India fund; South Park Commons bets on deeptech
n0d3077f1df.summary: Venture capital firm Accel has raised its ninth India fund, reported at $550 million in the ETtech morning newsletter. The same briefing also covered South Park Commons' deeptech bets.
n0d3077f1df.why: Accel is a global venture capital firm, and its India funds finance early-stage startups in the country's technology sector.

n2b7656699a.headline: Dollar subdued as markets await US inflation data for Fed clues
n2b7656699a.summary: Currency investors await US inflation data for signals on interest rates. Oil prices rose modestly on attacks on shipping routes, while the yen stayed near monthly lows despite joint intervention.
n2b7656699a.why: The US dollar is the world's main reserve currency, and US inflation data shapes Federal Reserve policy expectations that drive global currency and bond moves.

n0ce735807c.headline: Property tax changes complicate home ownership choices for couples
n0ce735807c.summary: The Korea Times reports that the government's latest property tax changes are affecting home ownership choices for couples in Seoul. The article cites a salaried worker in Dongjak District.
n0ce735807c.why: Property tax rules affect household housing costs and the investment case for residential real estate in South Korea.

n85df910c19.headline: Wall Street rises near a record as AI stocks climb and worries about inflation ease a bit
n85df910c19.summary: Wall Street finished just short of a record after several AI stocks reported stronger-than-expected growth. A report showed US inflation was slightly less bad last month.
n85df910c19.why: The S&P 500 tracks 500 large US companies and is the main benchmark for US equity performance.
n85df910c19.why_moved: Several AI stocks reported better-than-expected growth, and a report showed US inflation was slightly less bad last month.

n1b5ea74302.headline: Telecoms see AI businesses gain traction in Q2
n1b5ea74302.summary: Major Korean telecom operators are seeing early results from their push into AI, including AI data centers, cloud and AI transformation services, according to The Korea Times.
n1b5ea74302.why: Telecom operators are expanding into AI data centers and cloud services to diversify revenue beyond traditional connectivity.

n58f208ddd5.headline: Hyundai Elantra, Tucson get Rs1.4Million Price Shock after New Taxes
n58f208ddd5.summary: Hyundai Nishat Motors raised prices on all models by over Rs1.5 million in Pakistan, citing new taxes. Revised rates take effect from August 12.
n58f208ddd5.why: Hyundai Nishat Motors is the Pakistani unit of South Korea's Hyundai Motor, assembling and selling vehicles locally. Tax changes feed directly into car prices and demand.

nf7fea5d7b5.headline: MEF appeals to govt for MSME ‘survival’ package
nf7fea5d7b5.summary: The Malaysian Employers Federation acknowledges existing assistance for MSMEs but says aid is not reaching businesses quickly enough. It is appealing for a survival package.
nf7fea5d7b5.why: Micro, small and medium enterprises make up most Malaysian businesses, so their financial stress affects employment and domestic demand.

n75488a06ef.headline: Bangladesh’s development programme slows to 53-year low: Report
n75488a06ef.summary: Bangladesh implemented only 67.5% of its revised Annual Development Programme in FY2025-26, the lowest in 53 years, according to a Daily Star report.
